name: antigravity
description: Antigravity plugin for Claude Code: deep web research with citations, code rescue, task delegation, browser walkthrough recording, structured web scraping, document-to-markdown conversion, and visual/UX design review via Google Antigravity CLI (agy / Gemini 3.x). Seven slash commands — /agy:research, /agy:rescue, /agy:record, /agy:scrape, /agy:doc-to-md, /agy:design-review, /agy:setup — and a thin Bash forwarder. No Node.js runtime.
